column1: # ROUTER ADMISSION DEBT (#router-r1, ROUTER_PROGRAM §3.2 C2, §11.1 file 19) — registered
# capabilities whose OWN admission predicate the router cannot evaluate at start, so it
# reports Unknown (a refusal: today's route runs).
# Columns:  capability-id <TAB> kind <TAB> where the admission lives
#   inline      the admission is inline in a lane body (refactor it into a named function
#               the lane and the registry both call, then delete the row)
#   uncallable  a named predicate exists but needs an input the router must never build
# A RATCHET THAT MAY ONLY FALL: `router_admission_debt_matches_manifest` (ny-cli, --bin ny)
# fails on any delta. Removing a row is the payoff of making an admission callable; adding
# one means a new capability shipped without a callable predicate. Authored with the registry
# in the same commit (it is the registry's own data, printed by the test on any mismatch).
